name: Turkey (European part)

observations.reasoning: Sourced on 2026-07-27 after the ruling of the same day that counts transcontinental countries entire. Population on 1 January 2025: 85664944 inhabitants, recorded as 85.665 million. Eurostat dataset demo_pjan, read through the dissemination API, the same table and the same call as every other country here. This figure had already been read earlier in the day and refused, the denominator then asking for Eastern Thrace alone; the ruling removed that requirement and the figure is now simply recorded. Note what the ruling does not change: the schools indicator still counts European establishments only, which is why Anadolu Üniversitesi in Eskişehir stays excluded from this country's count. The two indicators no longer share a scope. Here that costs nothing, Turkey's schools count being zero under either reading, but the mismatch is real and is documented in the schema.
Opening estimate, produced with no source and no research. It exists to be falsified, not to be used as data.

Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. No establishment retained within this record's scope, and the reason deserves reading before the value. Turkey does have a course satisfying the denominator: the Puppet and Shadow Theatre branch of the state conservatoire of Anadolu University. But that university is in Eskisehir, in Anatolia, outside the European part to which the schema explicitly restricts this record. It is therefore not counted here. The performing arts departments checked, Suleyman Demirel, Uludag Bursa and Dokuz Eylul, have acting, dramatic writing and scenography as their specialisms, puppetry appearing only as a technique taught within scenography; none of them is in Eastern Thrace either. No course was identified in the European part, including the European side of Istanbul. The previous 0.5 was the midpoint of an estimated range. Upper bound at 1: Istanbul's universities were not checked one by one. A method point worth keeping for the whole series: the schema's geographical scoping can remove from a record a school that genuinely exists in the country.
